sinopsis.es: Una ex atleta de artes marciales debe enfrentarse a una red de usureros para salvar a su hermano menor, atrapado en una deuda de juego online y que pone en peligro la seguridad de su familia.
sinopsis.en: A former martial arts athlete must face a network of loan sharks to save her younger brother, who is trapped in online gambling debt and risking their family’s safety.
